data.name: Uptime 99.9%: Datacenter Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Uptime 99.9%: Datacenter Simulator is a technical management simulation where you build, operate and maintain your own server infrastructure. Monitor system performance in real time as you balance CPU load, temperature and power consumption. Keep your systems running and prevent failures that can disrupt your entire operation.

Start with a small setup and expand your datacenter. Install new servers, manage increasing load and optimize your infrastructure to achieve maximum stability and performance!

Operate and grow your own datacenter from the ground up and react to system issues accordingly. Improve your setup and push your infrastructure to its limits while maintaining control over performance and reliability.

But uptime isn't the only thing you'll need to keep track of. The longer you stay, the more this facility seems to demand of you and not everything about it adds up.

Key Features

  • Manage your own Datacenter

Deploy and operate multiple server types across rack slots and expand your infrastructure over time.

  • Real-time system simulation

Track CPU usage, temperature and power consumption as your systems run under load.

  • Prevent failures and downtime

Overheating, crashing and shutdowns impact your uptime and revenue directly.

  • Earn and expand

Maintain stable systems to generate income and reinvest into new hardware and upgrades.

  • Optimize for efficiency

Balance performance and stability to keep your uptime as high as possible.

  • Survive the unexplained

Something about this facility isn't right, piece together what's really going on as you keep the servers running.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
